# Sophia's Magical Princess Party

> Sophia's Magical Princess Party is a character entertainment company that has provided princess, fairy, K-Pop star and pop star impersonator performers for children's birthday parties, photoshoots and community events in the South Houston, Texas area since 2017. Performers wear park-quality costumes and stay in character for the whole visit, leading meet and greets, storytime, singalongs, games, makeovers and photo opportunities.

Key facts:

- Service area: South Houston, Texas and surrounding communities (travel fees may apply).
- In business since: 2017.
- Contact: call or text (832) 441-6539, email sophiasmagicalprincessparty@gmail.com, or use the contact form at https://sophiasmagicalprincessparty.com/#book
- Booking: submitting the contact form is a request for availability, not a confirmed booking. A $50 deposit holds the date; the balance is due before the party; invoices are sent through Square and cash is not accepted for bookings.
- Book 2-4 weeks ahead (weekends fill fast) and no more than 3 months ahead. Last-minute requests are not guaranteed.
- Entertainment only: decorations, food and photography are not provided. Parties can be at home or at a venue; the team can recommend venues.
- The characters are original characters inspired by classic stories and fables. The company is private and not affiliated with any production company or theme park.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sophiasmagicalprincessparty.com/): overview, how booking works, pricing calculator, reviews, FAQ and contact form
- [Characters](https://sophiasmagicalprincessparty.com/characters/): every available character with photos of each outfit and seasonal look
- [Photo gallery](https://sophiasmagicalprincessparty.com/photos/): photos from real parties and community events

## Pricing (estimates; final pricing confirmed when booking)

Princess characters:

- The Royal Greeting, 30 minutes: $165 for 1 performer, $265 for 2, $345 for 3. Meet and greet, photos, storytime and autographs.
- The Enchanted Party, 1 hour: $195 for 1 performer, $295 for 2, $395 for 3. Adds a singalong and an autographed certificate.
- The Magical Kingdom, 2 hours: $295 for 1 performer, $495 for 2, $650 for 3. Adds royal games, makeovers and tattoos.
- The Princess Photoshoot: $200 for 1 performer, with 15 photos delivered digitally (in partnership with Liv in Color).
- 4 or more princesses: call for pricing.

K-Pop star characters:

- The Idol Experience, 1 hour: $225 for 1 performer, $325 for 2, $425 for 3. Meet and greet, photos, singalong, dance and makeovers.
- Longer K-Pop parties: call for pricing.

Pop star impersonator (1 performer):

- The Celebrity Bash, 1 hour: $250.
- The Superstar Soiree, 2 hours: $450.

Personalized video messages from a chosen princess start at $50.

- The Snow Queen: Ice Gown, Spirit Dress, Winter Ice Gown
- K-Pop Trio: signature stage outfits and Golden outfits

## Photos

The gallery shows performers at real events, for example: the Snow Queen reading to girls at a spa birthday party, the Little Mermaid at the South Houston Moms Mommy and Me Fair, Cinderella at the Once Upon a Market event, the Bayou Princess at a spa party, Miracle Keeper leading a singalong at a sixth birthday, and the Snow Princess and Snow Queen performing at an outdoor holiday event. Every photo on the site has a written description in its alt text and in the page's structured data.

## Reviews

Families review the company on Google and Facebook, for example praising a Rapunzel visit as "kind, genuine" and a personalized Snow Queen video message as a favorite birthday gift.
